scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm --filter server dev" "pnpm --filter client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter client build
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build && node server/scripts/integration-test.mjs && node server/scripts/attachment-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:ui: pnpm build && node server/scripts/ui-smoke.mjs && node server/scripts/schedule-ui-smoke.mjs && node server/scripts/email-check-ui-smoke.mjs && node server/scripts/sms-schedules-ui-smoke.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter server typecheck && pnpm --filter client typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:integration
